changes_made.explanation: Removed redundant/duplicate dataset entries and normalized model names. The paper does evaluate machine translation outputs, making it an NLG paper.
All metrics are correctly extracted. BLEU and PER are used for intrinsic MT evaluation, while P@10 and MAP are used for extrinsic IR evaluation of the translated outputs.
No LLMs are used as judges in this paper (published in 2020, before LLM-as-judge became common). The paper uses traditional metrics and no LLM evaluation.
No human evaluation is conducted in this paper. All evaluations are automatic using BLEU, PER, P@10, and MAP metrics.

overall_notes: This paper is primarily a cross-lingual information retrieval (CLIR) paper that uses and evaluates machine translation systems as a component. While the main focus is IR, the paper does conduct intrinsic evaluation of MT outputs using BLEU and PER, making it qualify as an NLG evaluation paper. The MT systems are thoroughly evaluated and compared, with the translation quality being a key research question.
